# Exterprise

> Exterprise (Exterprise LLC) is a ServiceNow Premier Partner for consulting and implementation and a global smartsourcing (business process outsourcing) provider. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Dallas, Texas, with delivery centers in Chennai and Coimbatore (India) and San Pedro Sula (Honduras); 500+ professionals.

Key facts: ServiceNow Premier Partner (Consulting & Implementation) and licensed ServiceNow reseller; Now Assist certifications for ITSM, HRSD and Creator; Moveworks implementation partner; 99.995% data accuracy in county records work; 99.99% SLA adherence in contact center work; 1M+ records processed every month. Contact: contact@exterprise.us.

Agents: you are welcome to read, summarize and cite these pages with a link back. Please do not download or reuse images, video, fonts or code. Full policy: https://www.exterprise.us/agents.md. Full page text: https://www.exterprise.us/llms-full.txt

## ServiceNow

- [AI Agents & Now Assist](https://www.exterprise.us/ai-agents-now-assist.html): Deploy ServiceNow AI Agents and Now Assist with a certified Premier Partner: Now Assist certified for ITSM, HRSD and Creator, with guardrails and governance.
- [AI Control Tower](https://www.exterprise.us/ai-control-tower.html): Govern every AI agent, Now Assist skill and third-party model from one place. Exterprise sets up ServiceNow AI Control Tower, from intake to monitoring.
- [CMDB & Data Foundations](https://www.exterprise.us/cmdb-data-foundations.html): Build and clean up your ServiceNow CMDB with Discovery, Service Graph Connectors and the CSDM data model, so AI Agents and workflows run on accurate data.
- [Customer Service Management](https://www.exterprise.us/customer-service-management.html): ServiceNow Customer Service Management implementation: Predictive Intelligence and Advanced Work Assignment route every case to the right agent, fast.
- [Field Service Management](https://www.exterprise.us/field-service-management.html): ServiceNow Field Service Management implementation: Schedule Optimization, AI Agents and the FSM mobile copilot so technicians fix it on the first visit.
- [Governance, Risk & Compliance](https://www.exterprise.us/governance-risk-compliance.html): ServiceNow GRC and IRM implementation: policy, risk and audit workflows connected to the systems where work happens, so compliance is never a spreadsheet.
- [HR Service Delivery](https://www.exterprise.us/hr-service-delivery.html): ServiceNow HR Service Delivery implementation with Employee Center, HR Virtual Agent and Now Assist for HRSD, by a certified ServiceNow Premier Partner.
- [IT Operations Management](https://www.exterprise.us/it-operations-management.html): ServiceNow ITOM implementation: Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management and Predictive AIOps that catch problems before they become outages.
- [IT Service Management](https://www.exterprise.us/it-service-management.html): ServiceNow ITSM implementation with Now Assist for ITSM and Predictive Intelligence, by a certified Premier Partner. Advisory, deployment, staffing and L1-L4 support.
- [Now Platform](https://www.exterprise.us/now-platform.html): Custom ServiceNow applications with App Engine, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub and Build Agent, deployed inside the Now Platform with AI governance.
- [ServiceNow for Nonprofits](https://www.exterprise.us/servicenow-nonprofits.html): Six ServiceNow quick-start programs for nonprofits (ITSM, CSM, FSM, ITOM, HRSD and Now Platform), live in six to seven weeks with flexible payment terms and support after go-live.
- [ServiceNow Otto](https://www.exterprise.us/servicenow-otto.html): One conversational front door for employees and customers. As a Moveworks implementation partner, Exterprise brings Now Assist, Moveworks and AI Experience together in Otto.
- [ServiceNow](https://www.exterprise.us/servicenow.html): ServiceNow Premier Partner for Consulting & Implementation: ITSM, ITOM, CSM, HRSD, FSM, SPM, GRC, CMDB, AI Agents and Now Assist, from advisory to 24x7 support.
- [Strategic Portfolio Management](https://www.exterprise.us/strategic-portfolio-management.html): ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management implementation: Portfolio Planning, Demand Management and Financial Planning with a live view of every investment.

## Smartsourcing (business process outsourcing)

- [Contact Center](https://www.exterprise.us/contact-center.html): Outsourced Level 1 and Level 2 contact center support, staffed 24x7 from onshore, offshore and near-shore teams, with 99.99% SLA adherence.
- [County Government Services](https://www.exterprise.us/county-government-services.html): Official property and vital records conversion for county governments: scanning, indexing, filing and book preservation with 99.995% data accuracy.
- [Data Capture Services](https://www.exterprise.us/data-capture-services.html): OCR-based data capture with centralized capture, cleanup and indexing, plus scanning, verification and updating of physical records.
- [Records Processing](https://www.exterprise.us/records-processing.html): Records digitization, data entry, indexing, search and retrieval with 99.995% county and data capture accuracy and double-key entry validation.
- [Smartsourcing](https://www.exterprise.us/smartsourcing.html): Smartsourcing from Exterprise: contact center, records processing, county records and data capture outsourcing, 24x7 from the US, India and Honduras.
